**#2864 — NIP-60/61 wallet epic → DEFER-POST-V1 (add phase:post-v1)**
- Verdict: Feature app on top of the framework, not v1 framework surface. [...] **#2858 — X-Ray diagnostic surface epic → DEFER-POST-V1 (add phase:post-v1)**
- Verdict: Dev-build-only diagnostic tooling; by its own invariants it is NOT part of the shipped public/app surface.
- Evidence: Issue's own invariants: "Diagnostic surface is dev-build-only… `nmp-devtools` is a separate crate behind an off-by-default cargo feature, never linked by app code; CI asserts each platform's release-artifact dependency graph contains no `nmp-devtools`." It cannot be a 1.0 public-crate blocker because it is mechanically excluded from release artifacts. Flagship consumer is chirp#30 (external app). Most phases (B/C/D/E) are still open with large items (headless host runner, MCP server, Chirp pane) — clearly a post-v1 build-out. [...] **#2974 — Marmot MLS keyring CredentialStore never wired → DEFER-POST-V1 (keep open, add phase:post-v1)**
- Verdict: Genuine correctness defect, but in a feature that is NOT part of the v1 public surface.
- Evidence: Confirmed the bug — `grep -rn "set_default_store" crates` returns ZERO matches, so `MdkSqliteStorage::new`'s required global keyring store is never initialized; `is_registered` is permanently false for every identity on every platform, exactly as the issue traces. BUT: Marmot/MLS/NIP-EE has no v1 support row in `docs/nips.md` at all; the only reference (row 53, NIP-59) lists `nmp-marmot` as a "partial" protocol primitive, and NIP-17 DMs (row 37) are "partial" with explicit "v1 product docs must not claim complete DM UX." Encrypted MLS groups are not a v1 claim, so shipping 1.0 with this unfixed does not ship a *claimed* v1 feature broken. The fix also needs a net-new Android Keystore-backed `keyring_core::CredentialStore` (none exists in the ecosystem) — real post-v1 work.
- Action: Keep OPEN (it is a real bug for anyone using Marmot), label phase:post-v1. Fix it in the post-v1 DM/groups milestone, not before publishing 1.0. NEEDS-OWNER only if the owner wants Marmot groups pulled *into* v1 — nips.md says no. [...] - **#2864 (wallet), #2858 (X-Ray), #2974 (Marmot MLS) → labeled `phase:post-v1` + Backlog** — per `docs/nips.md` these are feature-app / dev-tool / non-v1-claimed surfaces, not framework blockers. #2974 stays open (it's a real bug, just post-v1).
